verdict.rationale: Supabase Cron provides native Postgres-based scheduling of recurring jobs with cron syntax and run monitoring, and Supabase Queues supplements this with durable message queue workflows, both directly accessible to AI agents via the documented MCP server/CLI integration. Missing for 10: no independent/hands-on evidence of AI agents actually orchestrating cron jobs end-to-end, and no documentation of complex multi-step workflow chaining beyond simple job scheduling.
